name: chat-anonimo
description: Zero-Knowledge ephemeral messaging suite with Blind Relay architecture, in-memory RAM cryptography (AES-256-GCM + ECDH), biometric voice obfuscation, duress decoy mode, and anti-forensic defenses.

paragraphs: A high-security messaging platform built on Zero Trust and zero forensic footprint principles. No accounts, no phone numbers, no database, no metadata retention: the cryptography runs in your browser's RAM and the server is a blind relay that cannot read what it forwards.

The thesis: true privacy is not merely hiding what was said, it is destroying all evidence that the conversation ever took place. If the server is seized or subpoenaed, there are no user logs, no databases and no keys: only an unauthenticated WebSocket pipe forwarding opaque byte streams through volatile RAM.
